notes: Thermal data (dn/dT, CTE) of the SCHOTT glasses: SCHOTT datasheet values as published in the refractiveindex.info database (CC0). Dispersion coefficients transcribed from publicly available manufacturer datasheets and peer-reviewed literature (sources per entry). Reference nd/Vd values are the published values used by the automated transcription check in tests/test_materials.py. Indices are relative to air. Verify against the current official datasheet before production use.

materials.name: PMMA
materials.source: G. Beadie, M. Brindza, R. A. Flynn, A. Rosenberg, J. S. Shirk, Appl. Opt. 54, F139-F143 (2015), 20.1 degC, absolute accuracy < 2e-4; coefficients as in the refractiveindex.info database (CC0). nd 1.49253, Vd 59.4. Polymer grades differ: for a specific grade use the maker's data as a custom material.

materials.name: POLYCARBONATE
materials.source: N. Sultanova, S. Kasarova, I. Nikolov, Acta Phys. Pol. A 116, 585-587 (2009), 20 degC; one-term Sellmeier fit of their data by M. Polyanskiy (refractiveindex.info database, CC0). nd 1.58476, Vd 27.9 (a smooth fit of the table of Zhang et al., Appl. Opt. 59, 2337 (2020), for another sample gives Vd about 28.1). Polymer grades differ: for a specific grade use the maker's data as a custom material.

materials.name: POLYSTYRENE

Polyanskiy (refractiveindex.info database, CC0). nd 1.59163, Vd 29.5 (a smooth fit of the table of Zhang et al., Appl. Opt. 59, 2337 (2020), for another sample gives nd about 1.589, Vd about 31.2). Polymer grades differ: for a specific grade use the maker's data as a custom material.
